name: Giving Advice
overview: Scripture teaches that giving advice wisely begins with the fear of the LORD, which is the foundation of true knowledge, while rejecting wisdom leads to folly (Proverbs 1:7). Trusting God rather than relying on our own understanding is essential, as human plans are ultimately directed by the Lord (Proverbs 3:5; 16:9). Those who heed counsel demonstrate wisdom, in contrast to fools who trust only their own perspective (Proverbs 12:15; 19:20). Furthermore, the willingness to receive admonition, regardless of age or status, reflects true wisdom and leads to a favorable outcome (Ecclesiastes 4:13).
